Extract cell types from deconvolution feature names

extract_cells.Rd

Reads the cell type of each deconvolution feature from its name, with the cell type vocabulary of multideconv (multideconv::get_cell_type_nomenclature(), plus cells_extra). The first vocabulary name found in the feature name is kept, and a _Subgroup.<n> suffix (or .Iteration.<n> of multideconv < 0.2.0) is removed. Vocabulary names are matched literally (a "." only matches a ".").

Usage

extract_cells(features, cells_extra = NULL)

Arguments

features

A character vector of deconvolution feature names: raw features (<method>_<signature>_<cell type>, or <method>_<cell type>) or subgroups (<cell type>_Subgroup.<n>).

cells_extra

Optional character vector of additional cell type names, added to the vocabulary.

Value

A character vector of the distinct cell types found (character(0) if none). Feature names without any vocabulary cell type are ignored.

Examples

extract_cells(c("Epidish_BPRNACan_Monocytes", "Monocytes_Subgroup.2", "Quantiseq_B.cells"))
#> [1] "Monocytes" "B.cells"  
extract_cells("Method_Signature_Mesenchymal.cells", cells_extra = "Mesenchymal.cells")
#> [1] "Mesenchymal.cells"
